9	> Platform: `Adobe Commerce PaaS`
10	
11	## Overview
12	
13	Adobe Commerce on cloud infrastructure — the PHP application (the
14	Magento framework plus Adobe Commerce modules) running on an
15	Adobe-managed PaaS, chosen when a project needs code-level control over
16	catalog, pricing, checkout or B2B flows, or has an existing Magento
17	investment. The storefront is either the native Luma theme or the
18	Commerce Storefront on Edge Delivery Services.
19	
20	## Stack by layer
21	
22	| Layer | Technology / Tool | Notes |
23	|---|---|---|
24	| Backend/Platform | PHP | Core development language |
25	| Backend/Platform | Composer | Dependency management; modules and the platform itself install as packages |
26	| Backend/Platform | Magento module architecture | Dependency injection, plugins (interceptors), observers, service contracts |
27	| Backend/Platform | MySQL | Database; schema changes through declarative schema |
28	| Backend/Platform | OpenSearch | Catalog search engine; required unless Live Search replaces it |
29	| Backend/Platform | Redis / Valkey | Cache and session storage |
30	| Backend/Platform | RabbitMQ | Message queues for asynchronous operations |
31	| Backend/Platform | GraphQL / REST Web APIs | Storefront and integration APIs |
32	| Backend/Platform | `bin/magento` | Setup, indexers, cache, deploy modes |
33	| Frontend | Layout XML + PHTML templates | Luma theme: page structure and server-rendered markup |
34	| Frontend | LESS | Luma theme: styling on the Magento UI library |
35	| Frontend | RequireJS | Luma theme: JavaScript module loading |
36	| Frontend | Knockout.js + UI Components | Luma theme: checkout, minicart and other dynamic UI |
37	| Frontend | jQuery / jQuery UI widgets | Luma theme: interactive widgets |
38	| Frontend | Commerce Storefront on EDS + Drop-ins | Alternative storefront on [Edge Delivery Services](aem-eds.md), with this platform as its backend |
39	| Extensibility | Adobe App Builder / API Mesh / Adobe I/O Events | Out-of-process extensions and integrations, kept outside the core |
40	| Commerce services | Storefront Compatibility package + Catalog Service | Required by the EDS storefront: the drop-ins read product data from Catalog Service |
41	| Commerce services | Live Search | Optional; powers the EDS Product Discovery drop-in — replaces OpenSearch for storefront search |
42	| Testing & QA | PHPUnit | Unit and integration tests (Magento's integration test framework) |
43	| Testing & QA | PHP_CodeSniffer + Magento Coding Standard | Coding standard checks |
44	| Testing & QA | PHPStan | Static analysis |
45	| CI/CD & tooling | `magento-cloud` CLI | Environment management and deployments on cloud infrastructure |
46	| CI/CD & tooling | `ece-tools` | Build and deploy hooks for cloud infrastructure |
47	| CI/CD & tooling | Cloud Docker for Commerce / Warden | Local Docker environment |
48	| Infrastructure & hosting | Adobe Commerce on cloud infrastructure | Adobe-managed PaaS: integration, staging and production environments |
49	| Infrastructure & hosting | Fastly | CDN, full-page cache and WAF — included with cloud infrastructure |
50	| Observability | New Relic | APM and infrastructure monitoring — included with cloud infrastructure |
51	
52	## Notes
53	
54	Luma and the EDS storefront are alternatives, not layers of the same
55	storefront: a project picks one. The EDS storefront needs a recent
56	Adobe Commerce version (2.4.8 or later per Adobe's storefront docs) and
57	the Commerce services above; check those prerequisites and their
58	licensing with Adobe before scoping it. OpenSearch and Live Search
59	can't both be enabled on the same instance.
60	
61	For the fully managed edition, see
62	[Adobe Commerce SaaS](adobe-commerce-saas.md). See also
63	the [shared technology stack](shared-stack.md) for cross-cutting tools
